description: This file contains unit tests for the ModuleActivator component within the OpenMRS platform, specifically testing the module lifecycle methods like startup, shutdown, stop, and unload events, ensuring correct invocation order and count during module activation/deactivation processes.

classes.name: ModuleActivatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class verifying the correct behavior and order of module lifecycle methods in the OpenMRS module system.

methods.name: shouldCallWillStartOnStartup
methods.description: Tests that the willStart() method is called exactly once for each module during startup.

methods.name: shouldNotCallStartedOnStartup
methods.description: Verifies that the started() method is not called during startup.

methods.name: shouldNotCallWillStopOnStartup
methods.description: Ensures that willStop() is not called during startup.

methods.name: shouldNotCallStoppedOnStartup
methods.description: Ensures that stopped() is not called during startup.

methods.name: shouldStartModulesInOrder
methods.description: Validates that modules start in dependencies order: module1, then module2, then module3.

methods.name: shouldCallWillStopAndStoppedOnlyForStoppedModule
methods.description: Verifies only the target module's willStop() and stopped() are called during module stop.

methods.name: shouldStopDependantModulesOnStopModule
methods.description: Ensures stopping a module also stops dependent modules in correct order.

methods.name: shouldCallWillStopAndStoppedOnShutdown
methods.description: Checks that all modules' willStop() and stopped() methods are invoked during shutdown.

methods.name: shouldExcludePreviouslyStoppedModulesOnShutdown
methods.description: Verifies that previously stopped modules are excluded from shutdown calls on re-shutdown.

methods.name: shouldCallWillStopAndStoppedOnUnloadModule
methods.description: Ensures only the specified module is affected during unload, not others.

methods.name: shouldStartBeforeAnotherModule
methods.description: Checks that module5 starts before module4 based on call timing.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Performs cleanup after all tests to ensure no residual state affects other tests.
